title: Svelte UI operational, control plane on a local branch

costar.context: The maintainer wants every application screen in Svelte and the control plane kept off the public line.
costar.objective: Prove the Svelte app runs, and put the control plane screens on local branch control-plane without pushing.
costar.style: Working SvelteKit routes and one local git branch.
costar.response: Public screens are login and calendar RSVP. The control plane is the unpushed branch.

concerns: A branch in this public GitHub repo is public if it is pushed.
Tenant/set has no fixture, so a guessed quota write could store a bad record.
The engine still embeds the gzipped HTML pages, so the running binary does not yet serve the Svelte build.
Committing the whole ui tree onto the private branch and then checking out main would delete the public screens from the working tree.
context: Login and RSVP already build. The control plane kernel is only markdown. Mail invite and alarm stay HTML because mail clients render HTML.
current_state: ui/ is untracked on main. npm run build already exited 0. The control plane has no routes.
target_design: Public Svelte screens stay uncommitted on main. Control plane routes, catalog, and adapter live only in a commit on local branch control-plane. That branch is not pushed. The control plane reads x:Tenant/get, x:Domain/get, x:Account/get, and GET /scim/ServiceProviderConfig. It does not send a quota write.
changes: State in the product rule that the control plane is local branch control-plane.
Add Svelte routes under ui/src/routes/(admin)/admin for directory, domain, account, and scim.
Commit only those paths on branch control-plane.
Check out main so those paths leave the public working tree.
Open the public screens in a browser and confirm they render.
boundaries: Do not commit the public UI onto main.
Mail bodies stay the HTML files the engine already parses.

verification.name: svelte-check
verification.proves: The Svelte app, including the control plane routes, typechecks before the branch split.

verification.name: branch-split
verification.command: git status --short && git log control-plane -1 --oneline && git branch -vv
verification.proves: The control plane commit exists only on the local branch and main's working tree no longer has those files.
verification.expected: control-plane is local, not tracking a remote; admin routes are absent on main
